title: Player Husk
description: Did I just see another of myself?
body:
# Husk
Something that not only looks like you but also copies and does your exact movements. Touching it will result in instant death.
## Multiplayer
In Multiplayer. Each player has their own Skinwalker. Contact with other player's Skinwalkers won't kill unless it's with your own Skinwalker.
## Difficulty
### Normal
_For babies._\
Husk deals 10 damage upon contact. (5 Hearts)
### Hard
_The default difficulty._\
Husk deals 15 damage upon contact. (7.5 Hearts)
### [NULLSCAPER](https://www.roblox.com/games/129279692364812)
_The true intended experience._\
Husks have halved spawn time. Two additional husks spawn. Husks always kill regardless of health upon contact.
## Settings
**#Value skinwalker.delay** | _100_ | Ticks till spawn after movement.\
**#SpawnValue skinwalker.delay** | _20_ | Ticks till an additional Skinwalker.\
**#Value skinwalker.amount** | _1_ | Skinwalkers to spawn when initializing.
## [Plate Havoc](https://modrinth.com/datapack/plate-havoc)
Introduces 2 new curses when playing Plate Havoc the random-events roguelike.
## Requirements
Minecraft 26.1+
